items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: For me to sit down and play the piano along with Horowitz and Rubinstein... it's very easy, because all you do is... You have these tremendous speakers... you have the actual sound.

ctx.x: mean, there's much more accuracy now. For me to sit down and play the piano along with Horowitz and Rubinstein, or Earl Hines, Fats Waller, it's very easy, because all you do is... You have these tremendous speakers, you know; it's right there in the room with you -- you have the actual sound. And the picture is there. You can vary the picture if you want to, from the machine to the piano -- not the piano to the machine. If you want to, you can slow it down, slow a tape down...
I mean, that's what people did in the old days with the piano rolls.
